source: Liz Kiernan's chr20 AFR-1000-random audit; see my_notes/flare_validation_notebooks_audit.md and lk_compare_ref_alt_records.ipynb
interpretation: Per-cluster (per-chrom) exact_overlap_pct from validate_ref_target_concordance.py should be >= 94.5 for a pass. The chr20 anchor scenario landed at 94.8; the 0.3-pct buffer accommodates per-cluster MAF differences.
pysam_split_state_caveat: validate_ref_target_concordance.py counts exact (chrom, pos, ref, alt) matches WITHOUT splitting multiallelics. The FLARE ref VCF is biallelic-SNPs-only; the per-cluster gt VCF may have multiallelics. Multiallelic-split mismatches surface as position_match_but_alleles_differ, which is the intended classification.
